[1] Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex, known in Japan as Mobile Armored Riot Police: Stand Alone Complex (Kōkaku Kidōtai Sutando Arōn Conpurekkusu ) , is a Japanese anime television series produced by Production I.G and based on Masamune Shirow's manga "Ghost in the Shell".
[2] I Stand Alone is a 1998 French art film written and directed by Gaspar Noé, and starring Philippe Nahon, Blandine Lenoir, Frankye Pain, and Martine Audrain.
[3] The narrative was continued in Noé's 1998 full-length debut, "I Stand Alone".
